summary:
Fixed the split-brain bug.

Changed [node.go](/app/app/cluster/node.go:123) so leader election now requires a real majority: `totalNodes/2 + 1`. For a 5-node cluster, that means 3 votes, so the 2-node partition can no longer elect a leader. I also fixed the leader log argument order.

Added a regression test in [node_test.go](/app/app/cluster/node_test.go:70) covering the 5-node `[0,1] | [2,3,4]` partition case.

Verification passed:
- `go test ./...`
- `./test.sh`

I rebuilt `/usr/local/bin/split-brain` from the current source before rerunning `test.sh`, because the script calls that installed binary.
